notes: Run backup now actually captures a snapshot on demand — previously the button queued a request that was never run. It records the snapshot and refreshes the list.

Restore a snapshot from Conditional Access → Backup & Restore: each backup has a Restore button that re-applies it over the tenant's live policies (with a confirmation). Microsoft-managed policies are left untouched.
Backup list rows redesigned — clearer Captured / Policies columns with Details + Restore actions; plus on-demand run and an editable daily/weekly schedule.
